import pandas as pd

# Source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_54/training_0.csv"
]

# List to hold dataframes
dfs = []

# Load each source file
for file_path in source_files:
    # Read CSV with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    dfs.append(df)

# Since all source tables have the same schema as the target,
# we perform a union (concatenation) of all source tables
combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# The target schema is ['condition', 'click'] with integer types
# Ensure the columns are present and cast to integer
combined_df = combined_df[['condition', 'click']].copy()
combined_df['condition'] = combined_df['condition'].astype(int)
combined_df['click'] = combined_df['click'].astype(int)

# Write the combined dataframe to the target CSV file
combined_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_54/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
